# Payroll Core V1 fixture cases

All values are invented. No row represents a real teacher, student, wage, renewal, refund or schedule record.

The cases are intentionally normalized rather than Excel-shaped. They cover:

1. one-to-one match;
2. unexplained one-to-one difference;
3. class match;
4. class difference explained by an effective-period configuration adjustment;
5. renewal-shaped source data;
6. refund-shaped source data;
7. a confirmed manual decision;
8. source teacher missing from payroll target;
9. payroll teacher missing from source;
10. an unprovided required field that keeps coverage partial.
